headings.usage: Use font-light for large marketing headers, font-black for numbers and metric highlights.

body.usage: All standard text, paragraphs, and descriptions.

monospace.usage: IP addresses, Security Scores, Threat Hashes, overlines, labels, and numeric metrics.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-2xl border-b border-white/10. Crucial for headers and sticky elements. Do not use plain transparency.
visual_enhancers.technical_grid: Apply a subtle background grid pattern using CSS radial-gradient or linear-gradient to ground the 'Command Center' feel.
visual_enhancers.borders: Expose the skeleton. Use 1px solid borders (border-border). Avoid soft shadows entirely in dark mode; rely on crisp borders and inner glows.
visual_enhancers.tracing_beam: Apply moving gradient borders (or animated SVG traces) to active Threat Alerts or the primary Premium Subscription card.
visual_enhancers.textures: Include a subtle noise overlay (opacity-20 mix-blend-overlay) over marketing sections to avoid flat digital outputs.

component_design.buttons: Sharp edges (rounded-sm). Primary action: bg-[#00E599] text-black font-semibold hover:bg-[#00c985] hover:-translate-y-0.5 transition-transform. Secondary: border border-[#27272A] bg-transparent text-white hover:bg-white hover:text-black.
component_design.cards: Flat solid background (#121215), 1px border (#27272A). For active/alert states, change border to threat/accent color.
component_design.badges: Square or very slightly rounded. Monospace font. bg-[#FF3366]/10 text-[#FF3366] for Malware; bg-[#00E599]/10 text-[#00E599] for Secure.
component_design.inputs: Shadcn inputs customized: bg-transparent border-b-2 border-l-0 border-r-0 border-t-0 border-[#27272A] focus:border-[#00E599] focus:ring-0 rounded-none.
component_design.progress: For malware scans, use thin progress bars (h-1) glowing with brand.accent.

grids.dashboard: Mode B (High Density). Base grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4. Gap-4. Every widget fills height exactly. No empty spaces. Heavy use of border-collapse style layouts.
grids.marketing: Mode A (Tetris). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8. Create asymmetry. Span-8 for hero text, Span-4 for 3D visual or stats.

layouts.navigation: Desktop: Slim side navigation (w-16 expanding to w-64 on hover) OR a top Crystal Glass nav. Dashboard must feel like a fullscreen app.
layouts.spacing: Use p-6 or p-8 inside dashboard cards. Use massive spacing (py-24 or py-32) on marketing page sections.

motion.interactions: Hover states must explicitly alter text color and background (e.g., hover:bg-white hover:text-black).
motion.scrolling: Implement Lenis smooth scrolling on the marketing landing page for a premium, weighty feel.
motion.feedback: Use Sonner for toasts (positioned bottom-right). Enter animations for dashboard widgets (staggered fade-up).

accessibility.contrast: Strict APCA compliance. Any text over brand.accent (Neon Green) MUST be black. Any text over threat (Red) MUST be white.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, toggles, scan triggers) MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='start-scan-btn').

media.icons: Use 'lucide-react' with a consistent stroke-width of 1.5. For critical alerts, animate the icon (pulse or shake).
media.illustrations: Avoid generic tech illustrations. Use high-contrast macro photography or abstract dark geometric patterns.

3d_libraries.recommendation: Use 'ts-particles' for a lightweight, interactive network mesh background on the landing page and VPN connection screen.
3d_libraries.charts: Use 'recharts' with a customized dark theme. Remove axis lines, keep grid lines faint (opacity-10). Use accent colors for data lines.

hero_background.description: Abstract dark network mesh for marketing hero background. Apply a heavy dark overlay to ensure text contrast.

feature_nodes.description: Floating cubes on black surface. Perfect for demonstrating 'Quarantine' or 'Encrypted VPN Nodes' in the features section.

server_infrastructure.description: Macro shot of neon green server lights. Use in the VPN server selection or Device Health Monitoring section.

instructions_to_main_agent.1: DO NOT use standard SaaS blue colors. Stick strictly to the Obsidian, Volt Green, and Signal Red palette defined.
instructions_to_main_agent.2: When building Shadcn components, strip away their default Vercel-like soft shadows and rounded corners. Enforce rounded-none or rounded-sm, and 1px borders.
instructions_to_main_agent.3: The App must feel like an elite security command center, not a generic B2B tool. Prioritize tension, asymmetry in marketing, and ultra-dense data display in the dashboard.
instructions_to_main_agent.5: Do NOT use transparent backgrounds on dropdowns or sticky headers; always apply a solid color or backdrop blur.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: 'transition: all'. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add '.App { text-align: center; }' in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.js (Note: use .js/.jsx not .tsx as this is a JS project).
